name: Lewis Hamilton
biography: Sir Lewis Carl Davidson Hamilton (born 7 January 1985) is a British racing driver contracted to compete in Formula One for Ferrari. Hamilton has won a joint-record seven Formula One World Drivers' Championship titles—tied with Michael Schumacher—and holds the records for most wins (105), pole positions (104), and podium finishes (202), among others.
